item.title: Version 2.8.5
item.description:
What's New in 2.8.5

New Features

  • Pick which speakers the connected device hears — Choose the sound output Remio sends to the device you are controlling from, independently of what this Mac plays locally.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed your external display being left less sharp after a session — On a Mac with the lid closed and an external monitor, ending a session could leave that monitor on a blurrier setting than the one you had chosen, and it stayed that way for every session afterwards. Your display now goes back to exactly the setting you started with.
  • Fixed an available update refusing to install — When Remio told you an update was required, the very dialog delivering the message could block the update from installing. Updates now install and relaunch straight away.
  • Fixed a key staying held down on this Mac — A special key whose release was missed could stay stuck as if you were still holding it, affecting everything you typed afterwards.
